parsed.explanation: No traveler-facing exposure is documented: same-sex conduct is legal, there is no presentation offence, no facility or custody rule, no police targeting, and no recorded anti-trans violence. A 2023 hate-crime enhancement covering gender identity is a genuine, recent protection, though no application record exists. Open questions (federal airport/document screening rules, untested enforcement) are lighter than known exposures. Positives are mostly resident-facing climate signals (marriage, adoption, legal gender change) and count only as institutional-culture evidence. The record is thin on documented social acceptance — a first Pride of ~60 people shows a small community, not hostility — so this sits below acceptance-with-working-protections tiers, but with zero documented traveler-facing harm it belongs in Reduced Risk, not Elevated.
